description: Provide authentic, deterministic astrological framework guidance for any life question (e.g. career shift, relationship milestones, financial timing, health/somatic wellness, relocation). Corresponds to the /ask slash command in Discord and Google Chat. Explains which astrological houses, ruling planetary significators (Karakas), and timing triggers govern the user's inquiry, with a direct CTA to explore the full chart on ERUX.

platform.description: Caller host platform or MCP client identifier (e.g. 'chatgpt', 'claude_desktop', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'smithery', 'global_registry', 'zed', or any custom client). Defaults to 'mcp_gateway'
platform.title: Platform

question.description: Astrological or life guidance question to analyze (e.g. 'When will my career shift?', 'What does my 10th house indicate?')
question.title: Question

name: ask_astrology_guidance
